name: ShopSavvy
description: Product lookup, current prices from tens of thousands of retailers and price history for AI agents, through a free hosted MCP server or the ShopSavvy Data API.

skills.name: Look Up Products
skills.description: Turns a barcode, ASIN, URL or model number into product details, one product at a time or in batches.

skills.name: Compare Retailer Prices
skills.description: Lists current offers for a product across tens of thousands of retailers, lowest first, with when each price was seen.

skills.name: Check Price History
skills.description: Returns a product's price history over a date range so an agent can judge whether now is a good time to buy.

skills.name: Monitor Price Drops
skills.description: Schedules hourly, daily or weekly refreshes and sends webhooks for price drops and availability changes.

skills.name: Read Buying Guides
skills.description: Pulls ShopSavvy best picks, buying guides and short reviews into the conversation to help choose a product.
